text: Nobody can tell what's real anymore.
A clip of cars driving down a sunny Miami street went viral this week.
and everyone thought it was real life.
The clip was posted by Only In Dade.
A page that normally posts real Miami videos.
Rockstar shared it on their own Instagram story and liked the post.
Fans were arguing in the comments.
Some said it was AI, some said it was a real street.
Recreating a real promo Rockstar did with West Coast Customs last month.
Except this time, it's all pixels.
If you can't tell the difference anymore,
What happens when the game actually comes out?
